No command substitutions, function calls, network operations, or file modifications occur at the top level. There is no evidence of malicious code execution or data exfiltration during sourcing.

Desktop file and icons are installed as expected. There are no suspicious commands, obfuscation, or unexpected file operations. The code aligns with standard packaging practices and poses no evidence of supply-chain tampering or malicious behavior.

Upstream functionality (e.g., downloading videos from supported platforms) is inherent to the application's purpose and not a sign of malicious intent in the package itself. No data exfiltration, remote code execution, or unauthorized system modifications are present.
